# bugs #3393: Designated initializer for a member of a nested anonymous union is missing from data images

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3393/
- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17192
- Recommended action: Apply after the patch for #2948 and close. The initializer lists under Related stay wrong.
- Patch: [bugs-3393.patch](../../patches/bugs-3393.patch), commit [`571f65449`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/571f654495ad2bba4a9ce75816d6308c7693abf1). Apply after `bugs-2948.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket has three cases. Trunk has fixes for two of them, and the patch is for the third.

- The reported case is the struct of `qct/0051-inits`, which has an anonymous union before a nested
  struct. [r16733](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16733/) corrected `createIvalStruct` in
  `src/SDCCast.c` for it and enabled `qct_0051-inits` for all targets.
- The case of the second comment is a union of several structs with bit-fields.
  [r16762](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16762/) applied patch #508 for it.
- The case of the third comment is `struct W` of `support/regression/tests/bug-3393-designated.c`
  with the initializer `{.a = 1, .t = 9, .z = 4}`. Where the compiler emits the object as a data
  image, the image is `01 00 00 00 04`. The correct image is `01 00 09 00 04`.

For mcs51 the third case is wrong for `const` and `__xdata` objects in every model, and for
file-scope objects without a storage class in the large and huge models. Code initializes the other
objects, and they are right. The three cases were run in ucsim on r17176 with the small, medium,
large, and huge models, and with `--stack-auto` for small and large. r17192 with the earlier
patches of this report gives the images of the third case too. An object that is a union has the
fault as well. `{.c = {1, 2}}` for `union V` of the test that the patch adds gives `00 00`.

## Cause

`promoteAnonStructs` in `src/SDCCsymt.c` puts the members of anonymous structs and unions into the
member list of the enclosing type and sets `anonunionalias` for the members of every alternative of
a union except the first. The list of `struct W` is `a`, `p`, `x`, `y`, `r`, `s`, `t`, `u`, `z`,
and `x`, `y`, `s`, `t`, and `u` have the flag. For each member, `printIvalStruct` in
`src/SDCCglue.c` calls `designatedAlternative`, which searches the row of members with the flag
that follows the member. It accepts a member of the row that has an initializer only when the
lowest offset in the row equals the offset of the member it was called for. Member `r` of the
first alternative separates the row `x`, `y` from the row `s`, `t`, `u`. The call for `p` searches
`x` and `y`. The call for `r`, at offset 3, finds `t` in a row that begins at offset 1 and returns
`NULL`. `printIvalStruct` then skips `s`, `t`, and `u` together with the initializer of `t`.

## Fix

The patch for #2948 makes `promoteAnonStructs` mark the first and the last member of each anonymous
struct or union. With these marks, `designatedAlternative` also examines each union that starts at
the member, from the outermost one, up to its last member, which the new `anonLast` finds. For the
first member of an object that is a union, it examines the whole member list. It returns the
member of another alternative when that member is not a bit-field and has the only initializer for
the union. For every other list it returns what the search of the row gave, so the image does not
change. A list with two initializers for one union can name two alternatives, of which C11
6.7.9p19 keeps the one written later, and the list that `reorderIlistFull` returns does not have
the order in which they were written.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/bug-3393-nested.c` has 16 assertions for `struct W`, for an object that
is a union, for an inner union that is not the first member of its alternative, and for three
unions that start at one member. The patch also enables the three checks that
`bug-3393-designated.c` has under `#if 0`. On r17192 with the earlier patches of this report,
`bug-3393-nested` fails 8 to 10 assertions on mcs51-small, mcs51-large, mcs51-small-stack-auto,
and mcs51-large-stack-auto, and `bug-3393-designated` with the three checks fails on mcs51-large
and mcs51-large-stack-auto. With the patch both pass on host, the six mcs51 variants (the four
models, and small and large with `--stack-auto`), stm8, and ucz80.

Two sets of constant objects were compiled with and without the patch. Of 106 objects with lists
for these shapes, 27 images differ, and 25 of the 27 are correct with the patch. Of 6400 objects
of random types with nested anonymous structs and unions and lists of one to three designators,
461 images differ, and the warnings do not differ. 449 of the 461 are equal to GCC's bytes with
the patch, and 12 differ from GCC's bytes with and without it. In both sets, every image that is
correct without the patch is unchanged.

For mcs51-small, mcs51-large, stm8, and ucz80, the assembly of the other regression tests is
identical with and without the patch. With the series of this report up to the patch for #3992
applied to r17192, the regression suite has 0 failures for host, the six mcs51 variants, stm8, and
ucz80, and the diagnostics suite has 0 failures for mcs51, mcs51-large, mcs51-stack-auto, z80, and
stm8.

## Related

- A list with more than one initializer for such a union keeps its image, also when the
  initializers are for members of one alternative. `{.a = 1, .s = 7, .t = 9, .z = 4}` for
  `struct W` gives `01 00 00 00 04`, and C gives `01 07 09 00 04`. The patch for #3979 emits
  several members of one alternative for unions whose first alternative does not have a union with
  members after it.
- A bit-field as the designated member of another alternative is not emitted. `{.c = 5}` for a
  union of `struct { union { char p; char q; }; char r; }` and
  `struct { unsigned b : 4; unsigned c : 4; }` gives an image of zeros.
- A positional initializer after a designated member of another alternative is assigned to the
  member after the union. The 2 images of the first set that stay wrong have such lists.
